description: This file defines the CampaignDetail React component, which fetches and displays details and analytics for a specific fundraising campaign, including campaign image, description, progress, and donation options.

methods.name: CampaignDetail({ user, onLogin, onDonateClick })
methods.description: React component that displays details for a specific campaign, fetches campaign data and analytics on mount, and renders campaign information along with donation buttons.

parameters.name: user
parameters.description: Current user object or null if not logged in.

parameters.name: onLogin
parameters.description: Callback function invoked when login button is clicked.

parameters.name: onDonateClick
parameters.description: Callback function invoked when donate button is clicked.

methods.return: React element rendering the campaign details page.
